title: Hosted endpoint geo-anchor wizard and evidence connector
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Provide a guided onboarding flow (geo-anchor wizard) that lets hosted API customers declare per-tenant region affinity, choose retention presets, and export a machine-readable evidence bundle for audits. The feature should combine a simple UX for common cases with an advanced mode exposing routing priority and soft-fail policies. The exported evidence bundle must contain attestable configuration, request routing logs, and retention policies for a configurable time window.
background: Compliance teams routinely ask for a verifiable trail showing where tenant requests were served and how long customer data was retained. Current hosted offering supports region pinning via a low-level policy API but lacks an end-to-end product experience or automated evidence packaging suitable for security attestations. This work reduces manual audit effort and lowers sales friction for enterprise deals.
scope: In scope: - Geo-anchor onboarding wizard in Console (wizard + advanced JSON editor) - Server-side operator that materializes tenant region manifests and validates compatibility with model placement - Retention preset selector mapping to retention enforcement configuration - Evidence connector that packages configuration, routing traces (sampled), and retention snapshots into a signed bundle (jsonl + manifest) - API & SDK endpoints for exporting/downloading bundles Out of scope: - Fleet-level cross-region migration tools - On-prem agent changes
success_metrics: - 80% reduction in average time to produce compliance evidence for hosted customers (measured in support tickets) - 25% increase in enterprise engagements closed where "region residency" was a gating factor - Evidence bundle validation tool passes internal audit checks in 2nd round
ux_notes: Wizard steps: 1) Select tenant + default region(s) 2) Choose affinity mode: hard-lock / soft-affinity / preferred list 3) Retention preset: 30d / 90d / custom 4) Routing fallback policy: nearest-region / failover-region / degrade-to-lower-tier 5) Review & attest (checkbox + signer) Advanced view: editable JSON manifest with schema validation and a preview of how traffic would be routed. Link to mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GeoAnchorMocks
api_changes: New endpoints: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/residency-manifest, GET /v1/tenants/{id}/residency-manifest, POST /v1/tenants/{id}/evidence-bundles?window=90d. Schema additions: residency_mode (string), preferred_regions (list of strings), retention_profile (string), signed_attestation (string). Backwards compatibility: existing policy API remains supported; wizard writes to both policy and manifest stores.
data_requirements: Evidence bundle must include: canonical residency-manifest.json (v1), sampled routing traces (ndjson, with sha256 digests), retention-config.json, and a signed manifest.json with timestamp and signing key id. Storage TTL for exported bundles configurable per-org.
security_and_compliance: Bundle signing uses customer-specific key reference (KMS reference) or Redwood signing key if enterprise allows. Audit trail for attestation actions recorded in audit-log service. Security review required: coordinate with Security (owner: Emily Chen). See minimal threat model in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RES/Geo+Anchor+Threat+Model
rollout_plan: 1) Internal dogfood in onboarding orgs for one week 2) Opt-in beta for 5 selected enterprise customers 3) Default visible to all hosted tenants but disabled by default with clear docs 4) GA after 4 weeks and audit pass
migration_and_rollback: If manifest validation fails during apply, operation is rejected with detailed error and rollback to previous manifest. Rollback strategy documented in runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Geo+Anchor+Runbook
acceptance_criteria: Console wizard exists end-to-end and persists manifests in the residency store
Exported evidence bundle validates against the internal schema and includes signatures
Routing respects residency manifest in >=95% of sampled requests in beta orgs
E2E tests and integration tests for API endpoints added to CI
Design sign-off completed and accessibility checks passed
